title: "Creating_New_Legends"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Fig. 4.8-2
```{r}
fake_dat<-data.frame("Heavy"=rnorm(10),
                     "Light"=rnorm(10),
                     "Moderate"=rnorm(10),
                     'Very Light'=rnorm(10))

fake_dat<-data.frame(year=rep(1:10, 4),
           extent=rep(c("Heavy","Light","Moderate","Very Light"), 10),
           numbers=rnorm(40))

plot<-ggplot(fake_dat, aes(x=year, y=numbers))+
  geom_line(aes(color=extent))+
  labs(color="Max Oiling Extent")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#9B100C","#A65F57", "#FFD0AD", "#FFF7E9"))+
  theme_bw()+theme(legend.title = element_text(face="bold"), 
                   legend.background = element_rect(fill=alpha("white",0.65)),
                   panel.background = element_blank(),
                   plot.background = element_rect(fill="blue"))

library(ggpubr)

leg<-get_legend(plot)
legend<-as_ggplot(leg)

ggsave("leg_test.png", bg="transparent")
```
